study: Five fresh independent simulated beginner mouse-only RILL composition attempts after latest-main rebase

protocol.study_type: Five fresh independent simulated beginners, not a human user study
protocol.agent_context: Fresh fork_turns=none tasks; no previous feedback, source code or peer sessions provided
protocol.task: Compose a 30-second piece using audio plus MIDI through a VST instrument, save the project and export WAV and MIDI using only a mouse. Give the piece a chosen name if possible. Before exporting, use the Mixer to balance the audio and MIDI track volumes and pan, try mute and solo, and create a bus and send if you can discover how.
protocol.comparison_note: Rounds7,8and9 use the same five musical personas, task, mixer follow-up, report questions, mouse driver, viewport, native VST, compiler/build profile and lab audio configuration. Earlier rounds did not explicitly ask for mixer exploration, so their ratings are historical context rather than a controlled comparison. Elapsed time includes screenshots, tool overhead and reporting pauses; it is not a human performance or hardware latency benchmark. Each cycle uses a separately frozen validated build.
protocol.inputs: Only screenshots plus logged click, double-click, drag, drag_hold, down, up, scroll and pointer move. No keyboard input, project injection or source inspection during attempt.
protocol.reset: Five new native windows on :981–:985, empty caches and fresh working directories. No projects or preferences from prior participants. Settings seed only 48 kHz / 1024 frames. Unmodified production starter audio and byte-identical native Rill Lab Sine VST3.
protocol.rating_scale: 1–5; higher means more of the named quality. Higher confusion is worse.
protocol.audio: Per-session timer-paced PulseAudio virtual sink via ALSA bridge at48kHz, Rill requested1024 output frames and PULSE_LATENCY_MSEC=60. No physical hardware or listening claims. Shared host, software graphics and virtual backend can affect responsiveness; this is not a latency benchmark.
protocol.validation: Independent read-only verification of saved project ZIP, embedded audio, native VST assignment, MIDI events and WAV samples; isolated analysis copies rendered with frozen binary to check actual audio and VST mix contributions. Original outputs remain unmodified.
protocol.reporting: Observable action/reaction summaries, screenshots and timestamped mouse logs, not private reasoning transcripts.
protocol.frozen_build: Native executable and adjacent plugin helper frozen only after coordinator confirms validation; git HEAD/main, staged+unstaged source diff, untracked source archive, full source hashes and executable hashes recorded.
limitations: No window manager; native dialog placement may differ from desktop installations.
Only the native laboratory sine VST is included; no third-party compatibility claims.
Audible quality is not assessed unless explicitly auditioned and documented.
fixed_questions: Did you complete and save the requested piece?
Did WAV and MIDI export show success?
Which mixer tasks could you discover and complete: volume, pan, mute, solo, bus, and send? Report the visible result or blocker for each attempted task.
What actions were easy or difficult, and what visible evidence supports each observation?
Rate ease, appearance, speed, confusion and feature completeness from1to5, explaining each rating.
What remains unverified, including heard audio and file contents?

build_conditions.comparison_note: Round7 and round8 use the same compiler/profile settings. Earlier rounds used debug-info builds; do not infer platform performance gains from cross-round timing.

participants.persona: Simulated first-time beginner interested in a short relaxed lo-fi sketch.

mixer_outcome.volume: Dragged drum and instrument faders; visible values changed from -6.0 to -8.2 dB and -2.5 to -6.6 dB. Balance chosen visually, not by hearing.
mixer_outcome.pan: Dragged drum pan left and instrument pan right; labels changed to Pan L15 and Pan R14.
mixer_outcome.mute: Clicked instrument Mute; button highlighted orange, then clicked again to turn off. No audible mute claim.
mixer_outcome.solo: Clicked instrument Solo; button highlighted teal, then clicked again to turn off. Meters were blank in the solo screenshot, with a subsequent output-stream warning, so audibility was not established.
mixer_outcome.bus: Clicked Add bus; New bus strip appeared with 0.0 dB and centered pan. After adding send it showed Bus 1 in.
mixer_outcome.send: Clicked drum Add send, then + Send, then New bus. Routing displayed a New bus send at 0.25x Post; mixer displayed Send · New bus.

participants.persona: Independent simulated beginner, first introduction to RILL, interested in a small electronic dance groove.

mixer_outcome.volume: Dragged both vertical faders. Circuit drums changed from -6.0 dB to -8.0 dB; New instrument changed from -2.5 dB to -8.9 dB. Values remained visible in final arrangement.
mixer_outcome.pan: Dragged the drum knob left and instrument knob right. Labels changed from C to L15 and R19 respectively.
mixer_outcome.mute: Clicked the drum Mute button; it highlighted amber in screenshot 12. Clicked it again to clear it before later work. Audible effect was not tested.
mixer_outcome.solo: Clicked instrument Solo; it highlighted in screenshot 13, with instrument/master meter activity after Retry playback. Clicked it again to clear it before save/export. Audible effect was not tested.
mixer_outcome.bus: Clicked Add bus. New bus appeared in the Mixer Buses group at 0.0 dB and centered pan, and later in the arrangement.
mixer_outcome.send: Clicked the instrument Add send, then + Send and New bus. The routing dialog showed New bus, level 0.25x and Post selected. The Mixer showed Send · New bus and the bus showed Bus 1 in. No effects were inserted and no audible bus processing was assessed.

participants.persona: Simulated first-time RILL beginner interested in a short melodic instrumental.

mixer_outcome.volume: Dragged drum fader from -6.0 to -8.4 dB and MIDI fader from -2.5 to -5.8 dB; both values remained visible in the final Mixer.
mixer_outcome.pan: Dragged drum knob horizontally to L15 and MIDI knob to R16; both values remained visible in the final Mixer.
mixer_outcome.mute: Clicked drum Mute on; amber highlighting appeared. Clicked it off before export. Audible muting unverified.
mixer_outcome.solo: Clicked MIDI Solo on; teal highlighting appeared, with MIDI/master meters active after playback retry. Clicked it off before export. Audible isolation unverified.
mixer_outcome.bus: Clicked Add bus; New bus strip appeared with 0.0 dB, center pan and output Ch 3 > Master. Final strip showed Bus 1 in.
mixer_outcome.send: Clicked MIDI Add send, then + Send, then New bus. Routing displayed New bus at 0.25x with Post selected. Final Mixer showed Send · New bus on the MIDI strip.

participants.persona: Simulated beginner, first introduction to RILL, interested in a short ambient soundtrack sketch.

mixer_outcome.volume: Dragged the audio fader down to -12.0 dB and MIDI fader down to -6.0 dB; numeric values visibly updated. Bus remained at 0.0 dB.
mixer_outcome.pan: Dragged the audio pan knob horizontally left to L14 and MIDI right to R21; labels visibly updated.
mixer_outcome.mute: Clicked audio Mute during transport playback and observed orange active styling; clicked again to restore inactive styling. Audible muting not verified.
mixer_outcome.solo: Clicked MIDI Solo and observed green active styling; clicked again to restore inactive styling before export. The stream-error banner appeared during this part of the session; no causal or audible claim.
mixer_outcome.bus: Clicked Add bus and observed a new New bus strip, later displayed as Bus 1 in after adding the send.
mixer_outcome.send: Clicked MIDI Add send, then + Send, then New bus. Routing displayed a New bus send at 0.25x with Post selected; Mixer displayed Send - New bus. No effects were added to the bus.

participants.persona: Simulated first-time RILL user interested in a short hip-hop beat with a simple synth part.

mixer_outcome.volume: Dragged both Mixer faders. Audio changed from -6.0 to -7.5 dB; MIDI changed from -2.5 to -9.6 dB. These final values were visible before exporting. Balance was set visually, not by listening.
mixer_outcome.pan: Dragged each Mixer pan knob horizontally and vertically. Final displayed values were audio L25 and MIDI R28.
mixer_outcome.mute: Clicked Circuit drums Mute; its button highlighted amber. Clicked again to disable before saving/exporting.
mixer_outcome.solo: Clicked New instrument Solo; its button highlighted teal and MIDI/master meters were visible. Clicked again to disable before saving/exporting.
mixer_outcome.bus: Clicked Add bus. A New bus strip appeared at 0.0 dB, centered, output to Master. After adding the send it displayed Bus 1 in.
mixer_outcome.send: Clicked the audio strip Add send, then + Send, then New bus. Routing showed New bus, 0.25x level, Post selected. Mixer showed Send · New bus. No bus effects were inserted.

comparison_limits: Rounds7and8 add an explicit mixer task absent from earlier rounds; only round7→8 is directly comparable.
Elapsed time includes screenshots and reporting; input events include new held-gesture actions and are not equivalent to physical gesture counts.
Round1 did not explicitly encourage a chosen project name; later rounds did.
Each round evaluates its frozen build; ratings are never retroactively applied to later fixes.
